**Manipulation of Data in R Programming**

```{r}
library(tidyverse
```

```{r}
data("msleep")
glimpse(msleep)
```

Rename a Variable

```{r}
msleep %>% 
  rename("Conserv" = "conservation")


```

Reorder variables if you want Vore,name then everything else

```{r}
msleep %>% 
  select(vore,conservation,everything())


```

Change a variable Type

1.  Identifying the type of variable we use the class function in r

    ```{r}
    class(msleep$vore)
    ```

2.  Changing vore to factor

<!-- -->

    ```{r}

    msleep$vore = as.factor(msleep$vore)
    ```

```{r}
glimpse(msleep)

```
